chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us from his uncle Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Kufi from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ziyad ibn al-Mundhir from Sa'id ibn Jubayr from Ibn Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Whoever opposes Ali ibn Abi Talib after me is a disbeliever, and whoever associates partners with him is a polytheist. Whoever loves him is a believer, and whoever hates him is a hypocrite. Whoever follows his traces is an adherent, whoever wages war against him is a traitor, and whoever rejects him is in falsehood. Ali is the light of Allah in His lands, and His proof upon His servants. Ali is the sword of Allah upon His enemies, and the inheritor of the knowledge of His prophets. Ali is the exalted word of Allah, and the word of his enemies is lowly. Ali is the master of the deputies and the deputy of the master of prophets. Ali is the Commander of the Faithful, the leader of the radiant believers, and the Imam of the Muslims. Allah does not accept faith except with his wilaya and his obedience.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful: the preeminent title of Ali ibn Abi Talib
key_terms.سَيِّدُ الْأَوْصِيَاءِ: Master of the Deputies: Ali's rank as chief among all prophetic successors
key_terms.وِلَايَتِهِ وَطَاعَتِهِ: His wilaya and obedience: the authority and guardianship of Ali, acceptance of which is a condition of valid faith

ai.seo_question: What titles did the Prophet Muhammad give to Ali ibn Abi Talib in al-Amali of Sheikh al-Saduq?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) enumerated the comprehensive titles and stations of Ali ibn Abi Talib in a declaration transmitted through Ibn Abbas: whoever opposes Ali after the Prophet is a disbeliever, whoever associates others with him is a polytheist, whoever loves him is a believer, whoever hates him is a hypocrite. Ali is described as the light of God in His lands, His proof upon His servants, the sword of God against His enemies, the inheritor of prophetic knowledge, the exalted word of God, the master of all deputies, the deputy of the master of prophets, the Commander of the Faithful, the leader of the radiant believers, and the Imam of the Muslims. Faith is not accepted without his wilaya and obedience.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Ali (rh) narrated to us from his uncle Muhammad b. Abi al-Qasim from Muhammad b. `Ali al-Kufi from Muhammad b. Sinan from Ziyad b. al-Mundhir from Sa`id b. Jubayr from Ibn `Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

Whoever opposes `Ali b. Abi Talib after me is a disbeliever, and whoever associates partners with him is a polytheist. Whoever loves him is a believer, and whoever hates him is a hypocrite. Whoever pursues what he leaves behind is in pursuit [of Paradise], whoever is at war with him is a traitor, and whoever turns away from him is in falsehood. `Ali is the light of Allah in His cities, and His Proof over the worshipers. `Ali is the Sword of Allah upon His enemies, and the inheritor of the knowledge of His prophets. `Ali is the exalted word of Allah, and the words of his enemies are lowly. `Ali is the Master of the Deputies, and the Deputy of the Master of Prophets. `Ali is the Commander of the Faithful, the Leader of the shining believers, and the Imam of the Muslims. Allah does not accept faith except in his wilaya and his obedience.
